limitations: Nominal is a mapwide configuration target; it is not a per-building count or a promise of finding an item within a number of minutes.
Map prototype checks omit regional tier geometry, live occupied slots, model dimensions and native class/config availability.
Configured magazine attachment links come from mission XML; the installed game and mod config must still accept those exact classes/attachments.
Ammo stack changes apply when the CE creates new supplies; existing saved items are not refilled or replaced.
Existing worlds refill over normal CE cycles after restart, subject to occupancy and player distance. No persistence wipe or forced loot reset is performed.

sources.supports: CE extension files may override individual scalar fields; repeated flags and usages are rewritten as complete groups.
Initial/restart population, spawn avoidance, proxy placement and spawn attempt limits remain engine-controlled.
The official ammoPolice preset includes 5.56 and 5.45 supplies, supporting Police as an ordinary resupply theme.
